name: Parallel Session Concurrency Skill
purpose: Coordinates multi-project concurrent production sessions without hardware resource contention, memory exhaustion on Apple Silicon, or workspace governance collisions.
capabilities: Hardware resource locking (Render and TTS mutexes via scripts/session-guard.py)
Non-blocking wait queues with periodic progress logging
Git worktree isolation for concurrent project branches (session-start/end)

installation.instructions: Built-in workspace skill. No installation needed.

compatibility.notes: Protects Apple Silicon M2 unified memory by serializing Chromium and PyTorch workloads.

security.notes: Coordinates locks via .locks/ and runs guarded project commands.

approval_evidence: Production tested with concurrent lock acquisition and project-scoped governance gates.
